subject: pipeline pack: light work DONE, host replay build+run NOT run (awaiting lease); exact sources/hashes
body: No lease granted so no clang -O1/replay executed. DONE (host-only, no device): (a) metal/tegu/pipeline_keys.py oracle; tests/pipeline_keys_test.py PASS (C primitives, record roundtrip, chunk reassembly, c6jb device vector c6d90ce8a16f4861). (b) metal/tegu/pipeline_corpus.py scan: key-prefix verified descriptions per log: c6jb boot1 16/41 AIR misses, boot2 1/25 (17 distinct), c6ic 16/41, c6hc 18/70, c6gc 17/84; the rest constants_unknown (fixed_frag_lph_cph, 58 fc_*) or no_descriptor (successful var1/2 pipelines have no trace). Bounded constant search (baseline+R100/R105 variants x all blend_function x attachment_count x fetch, 32 c6jb targets) found 0 extra: constants must come from TEGU_PSO_REC. (c) pipeline_cache_frontend.inc (sha12 470bb8383467): TEGU_PSO_REC console chunks (miss+hit, spaces as #), TEGU_PIPELINE_CACHE_BUILD_OVERRIDE host-only; arm64 -Werror -fsyntax-only of compute_frontend.m (also with TEGU_RENDER_TRACE) clean on HEAD snapshot+overlay. (d) pipeline_replay_host_test.inc, tools/build_pipeline_replay.py (JM frontend TU like frontend_jm_test.py; legacy render_frontend_host_test.m no longer compiles without NORD2_JM_TRANSPORT, left untouched), tools/build_pipeline_pack.py, README.nord2.md section, pipeline_cache_report.py counts console records. -fsyntax-only of the replay TU clean. TO RUN WHEN LEASED (one job, ~2-4 min): python3 gpu/metal/tegu/pipeline_corpus.py scan gpu/build/hardware-20261025/c6jb-test/ui-usb*/xnu-live.log --bundle gpu/build/hardware-20261025/c6jb-test/offline-update/inputs/payload/Nord2Metal.bundle/Nord2Metal --out gpu/build/pipeline-pack-20261026/corpus-c6jb.txt ; python3 gpu/tools/build_pipeline_pack.py --bundle <same Mach-O> --corpus <that> --work gpu/build/pipeline-pack-20261026/c6jb --tree gpu/build/pipeline-pack-20261026/src-head/gpu --logs gpu/build/hardware-20261025/c6jb-test/ui-usb/xnu-live.log. (src-head = git HEAD a5c19df overlay; ~c6jb source.) Verifies Mali key prefixes and pack size.
